desc:
A booking and scheduling web app lets clients choose a service, see real availability and book without calling you. Ecom Swift LLC builds the calendars, rules, reminders and admin view, and connects them to your own website and calendar.

## What is a booking and scheduling web app?

A booking and scheduling web app is an online system that shows when you or your staff are free, lets a client reserve a slot and records the appointment in one place. It replaces the phone calls, direct messages and email threads that usually settle a time.

Behind the simple booking page sits a set of rules: which services exist, how long each takes, when each person works, what gaps are needed between visits and which days are closed. When those rules are right, clients can only pick times that genuinely work.

## Why manual booking costs more than it seems

Every appointment arranged by message takes several replies. Double bookings happen, reminders get forgotten and no-shows leave empty gaps that cannot be refilled. Clients who find it hard to book often book with someone else instead.

An online booking page works while you are with a client or asleep. The calendar becomes the single source of truth, so staff stop comparing notes and start serving people.

## How booking affects your results

Booking turns interest into a commitment at the moment a visitor is ready. Showing availability right on the page removes the pause where people change their minds. Confirmation emails reassure clients, and reminders before each visit reduce missed appointments, which protects your income and your time.

For businesses that take payment at booking, the money arrives before the visit, which makes no-shows less painful. Reports on bookings and no-shows show which services and times are popular, so you can plan staffing and offers on evidence rather than memory.

## What a great booking system includes

- A clear list of services with durations, descriptions and optional prices.
- Weekly availability per person, with holidays and time off blocked out.
- Buffer times before and after appointments for travel, cleaning or notes.
- Correct handling of time zones, so a client in another city sees local times.
- Confirmation and reminder emails, and text reminders where needed.
- Reschedule and cancel links that follow your rules.
- Two-way sync with Google or Outlook calendars so nothing clashes.
- An admin view to see, move, cancel or add bookings by hand.
- Payment at booking, class passes or packages for businesses that need them.
- A booking page embedded neatly in your existing website.

## What we do

We begin by mapping your services, staff and rules, including the awkward exceptions. Then we build the booking page, the availability engine and the emails, and connect your calendar. We test with sample bookings across different days, time zones and staff before you share the link.

The Basic package provides a booking page for a few services, availability, confirmation emails, an admin list and embedding on your site. Standard adds more services, several staff calendars, reminders, calendar sync and reschedule links. Premium supports a large number of services and staff, payment at booking, packages and class passes, email and text reminders and a booking and no-show report. Add-ons include extra staff calendars, a waitlist and an intake form.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Write down your real opening hours, breaks and lead times.
- Set buffers that match how long you need between clients.
- Decide your cancellation and rescheduling rules before launch.
- Test a full booking on a phone, as most clients will book there.
- Keep one calendar as the master record.

**Avoid:**
- Offering every time slot when you cannot actually meet them.
- Hiding cancellation rules until after the booking.
- Running two separate calendars that do not sync.
- Asking for long forms before the client has picked a time.
- Switching on text reminders without checking consent rules for your region.

## Who it is for

This service suits a salon, clinic, studio or consultancy tired of phone tag, a tutor or coach who sells sessions and class passes, and a small team of mobile staff who need clean calendars. It also suits a business that has outgrown a basic booking widget and wants rules that match how it works.

## What we need from you

Send your services with durations, your staff and their working hours, and your policies for cancelling and rescheduling. Tell us which calendar you use. We never need your passwords. Where a calendar or payment account is involved, you connect it yourself or add us as a collaborator or developer user.
